claims.evidence: Witness report shows a partially disassembled car engine bay/engine assembly with no readable brand/model label.
No documentation, markings, or labels indicating Belgium origin are shown in the witness observations.
Witness report shows dirt/grease staining and missing/removed upper components; no start/run video, sound clip, or test result is shown.
No mileage/odometer reading or ECU mileage screenshot is shown.
Witness report indicates the engine appears disassembled with parts separated and missing upper components, which contradicts 'never opened' in the visible state.

risks.risk: Engine make/model and exact variant may not be LX460/Japan spec; wrong engine could be incompatible with the buyer’s setup.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of the engine block/ID plate and stamped engine code (and/or ECU label) plus a photo showing the full engine with all identifying markings readable.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unidentified used engine/part set (worst-case compatibility risk).

risks.risk: Condition is unknown: may not actually start/run; internal damage (bent valves, worn bearings) may exist despite claims.
risks.proof: Short video of the engine starting and idling (cold start if possible) and a clip showing no smoke/knocking, plus a compression test sheet or scan report.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case: needs overhaul).

risks.risk: Partial disassembly suggests missing components or incomplete assembly (ECU, alternator, starter, sensors, wiring harness, cooling parts).
risks.proof: Inventory photo list: show each major component included (ECU, alternator, starter, sensors, wiring harness, intake/exhaust manifolds, radiator/hoses if applicable) laid out and labeled, and a full assembled view.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/parts-only set (worst-case: buyer must source missing parts).

risks.risk: Leak/contamination risk: visible oil/grease staining could indicate active leaks or heavy seepage.
risks.proof: Leak test evidence: clean the engine then show fresh leak points after running, or provide a video of the engine running with a clean baseline and no new leaks.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential leak/maintenance needed (worst-case: reseal/repair).

risks.risk: Cooling system and related hoses/pipes may be damaged or mismatched, leading to overheating.
risks.proof: Close-ups of all cooling-related components (radiator/hoses/thermostat housing/water pump area) and confirmation of included parts with condition checks.
risks.if_unproven: Price as cooling system unverified (worst-case: replace hoses/pump/thermostat).

proof_requests: Send clear close-up photos of the engine block stamped code/ID plate and any ECU label so the exact make/variant can be confirmed.
Provide a short video of the engine starting and idling (with sound) and a second clip showing it revving briefly without knocking/smoke.
Share compression test results (or a scan report) and any diagnostic report used for the 'tested and working' claim.
Show an inventory of included parts (ECU, alternator, starter, sensors, wiring harness completeness, intake/exhaust manifolds, turbo if any, and all mounting/bolt condition).
Provide photos of cooling system components (radiator/hoses/thermostat housing/water pump area) and confirm they are included and not cracked/bent.
response.reason: The witness can confirm it’s a used engine assembly that appears partially disassembled, but cannot confirm the Lexus LX460 identity or working condition from the visible evidence. Without proof of exact variant and functional testing, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
